title: Earthworm
httpBody: Earthworm runs inside a secure (https) desktop, and a browser will not load an insecure (http) page inside it. This is a browser security rule, not a limit of Earthworm.
refusedTitle: This site can’t be shown here
refusedBody1: did not load in the frame. The usual cause is that the site forbids being displayed inside another page.
refusedBody2: Many sites refuse to be embedded, as a security measure. This is the site’s choice, not a limit of Earthworm.
drifted: A link was followed inside the page; its address is not visible. Back returns to the address shown.
